BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India -> COPENHAGEN, DENMARK | HS 84717020 | BOL 9396532". Buyer-side aggregation on the same page shows "81 SPRAGUE EUROPE BV ... SUREWORKS INFOTECH PRIVATE LIMITED" and "5 NORDIC COMPUTERS ... SUREWORKS INFOTECH PRIVATE LIMITED". Source counter: page states Total Shipments 183 / Trading Partners 18 / Ports 21; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows (3 inbound, 2 outbound) plus 5 supplier and 5 buyer aggregate rows.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split was retrievable: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and eximpedia/volza free views returned HTTP 403. Nothing found either way — not evidence of absence.
note: Declared HS 847150 (ADP machines/processing units) is broadly consistent with the observed trade: the company ships refurbished/used enterprise IT hardware — tape drives (84717040), HDDs (84717020), motherboards (84733020), server/storage parts (85437099). No HS correction needed. IMPORTANT: the customs record is dominated by INBOUND flows (imports from CXTEC, Nordic Computers, Evernet International SAS, Sprague Europe BV into Bangalore ACC), i.e. Sureworks is primarily a buyer of used enterprise hardware; the outbound rows above are genuine export shipments but are a minority of the 183 records and the free view does not show the full export/import split, so export volume cannot be quantified. Revenue and export value: null — not public in the free views. Domestic supply: no trace found in accessible sources; status unknown, not 'declared_only', because no company claim was verifiable either. No registry/catalogue data used.
